description: Seasonal dressing for any outdoor scene.

items.text: early spring, fresh green shoots and drifting blossom petals

items.text: high summer, saturated greens, strong sun and deep cool shade

items.name: late-summer-gold

items.name: winter-thaw
items.text: the first thaw, patchy melting snow, dripping icicles and dark wet earth

items.name: monsoon-lush
items.text: monsoon season, dripping oversaturated greenery and heavy humid air
